messages:
jessica_support: FYI escalated ticket from Acme — they see many requests routed to eu-01 even though client sets X-Redwood-Region: us-west. Customer says it started after a proxy upgrade.

customer_acme_ops: seeing a ton of cross-region latency for our prod traffic. header we send: `X-Redwood-Region: us-west` — yet responses come from eu. Any idea?

sre-bot: New alert: 3xx% of requests from acct-acme routed to eu-01 in last 15m. Top reason: router fallback due to header parse failure.

jessica_support: Attached their curl repro.

customer_acme_ops: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'X-Redwood-Region: us-west' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate```

martin_router (via tim_router): quick note — router treats header as authoritative if valid token; otherwise falls back to nearest-pop. If header contains disallowed chars we log parse error and run fallback. Can you paste raw header bytes?

customer_acme_ops: we passed this back: `X-Redwood-Region: us-west\r\n` from our edge before the proxy upgrade. Not sure why that's invalid now.

alex_oncall: I pulled the logs for their client IP. Router shows header value: `us-west\x00` (NUL byte) for ~12k requests. Proxy upgrade replaced trailing CRLF handling and now appends a NUL when header trimming misfires.

maria_engineering: that NUL makes our header parser treat it as non-token and reject. It falls through to region resolution which picks eu-01 because of their origin geo (post-proxy path).

jessica_support: Customer notes they only see this after upgrading the proxy — sending vendor+proxy details.

customer_acme_ops: vendor: proxycorp 2.4.1 -> 2.5.0, enabled header-sanitizer feature by default. We rolled back to 2.4.1 and traffic normalized within ~10m.

tim_router: Repro steps (internal):
1) inject header with trailing NUL: `printf "X-Redwood-Region: us-west\0\r\n" | nc -q0 -w1 api.redwood`\2) router logs: `region_parse_error: invalid_token` then `route_fallback: nearest-pop eu-01`

maria_engineering: Proposed fix: make parser robust to trailing control chars — trim C0 controls before token validation and add metric for malformed-region-header. Also add a mitigation rule: if header startswith "us-" or "eu-" pattern but fails strict parse, run a soft-accept heuristic (with logging) to avoid cross-region fallback.

alex_oncall: For immediate mitigation, support team can add a transient routing exception for acct-acme to honor header if header contains ascii letters/dash only after trimming C0. Will coordinate with infra.

jessica_support: I shared rollback note with customer and asked for confirmation once they upgrade proxy with sanitizer off. Customer already rolled back and confirmed reduced latency.

maria_engineering: Filing a low-risk parser patch and a monitoring alert: `malformed_region_header_rate` > 0.1% triggers pager. Adding to backlog for next deploy.

jessica_support: Closing loop with customer and documenting repro + recommended proxy config in KB. Thanks everyone :pray: 

customer_acme_ops: Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage.
